purpose: Repair the three trace-verified v9.5 failure classes: coarse terrain routing, reachable local contact, and post-disappearance pickup

evaluation.smoke_note: development diagnostics on the v9.5 gate-v2 failure seeds; these seeds are burned for holdout purposes
evaluation.smoke_result: smoke v1: 3/4 (16702 success 258 steps with one successful terrain climb burst; 16714 failed at the cap after three bounded replan cycles but reached in-range attack, block disappearance, and a near-miss elevated pickup with 31 steps left; 16716 success 191 steps with one rescan-success loop reset and an elevated pickup; 16719 success 233 steps with eight elevated jumps); zero contact-owner mismatches in all four runs
evaluation.training_gate: at least 18/20 success, at most two 300-step failures, at least one success after coordinate recovery, contact owner mismatches zero, and no oracle or log grid used for actions or scoring
evaluation.training_gate_result: formal unseen gate v1: 18/20, Wilson 95% 69.9%-97.2%, mean 140.35, median 111, two 300-step failures (16805 post-disappearance pickup with a 4.5-block vertical gap; 16812 budget exhaustion after a failed first exact rescan), zero contact-owner mismatches, three successes after coordinate recovery

failure_model.16702: coarse terrain routing: plain forward cannot climb one-block staircases, two obstacle recoveries per candidate then replan-rescan exhausted the 300-step budget before any contact
failure_model.16714: reachable local contact: premature visual handoff paid a failed 40-step exact rescan, then the remembered 3-D log sat 6-13 blocks away uphill with no climb assistance in coordinate aim
failure_model.16716: exact-rescan success was discarded one step later by a stale centring-loop budget, wasting the first tree attempt; the remaining ten steps were too few for pickup of a drop 2.5 blocks above the player
failure_model.16719: post-disappearance pickup: the drop rested 3.5 blocks above the player on a lower trunk block; the 2-D ring planner burned 66 blocked waypoints without jumping under the block column

note: Independent v9.6 profile. v9.5 and older profiles remain frozen; every new mechanism defaults to disabled and is enabled only by this profile.
